newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Shorter wait to register Ukraine T-bills-c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Shorter wait to register Ukraine T-bills-c.bank.

text.p: Ukraine has introduced an automatic re-registration system for Treasury bills which has significantly cut waiting periods for clients, a central bank official said on Friday.

"Before, we were re-registering the ownership manually, and it was possible that if the OTC market was very large, the time needed for registration took one to two days," said Vitaly Migashko, head of the capital markets and exchange department.
The central bank began automatic re-registration of ownership on August 19.

Ukraine regularly issues discount three-, six-, nine- and twelve month T-bills and recent yields have been averaging 50-60 percent. It began issuing Treasury Bills in March 1995. --Irene Marushko, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
